data.name: UserAgreement
data.value:
SecRandom User Agreement (Version 1)
1. Scope and acceptance. SecRandom is a random selection tool for educational activities. By continuing to use the software, you accept this agreement; it does not remove rights granted by applicable law.
2. Permitted use. You may use the software for classes, teaching activities, and other lawful internal random-selection scenarios.
3. User responsibilities. Ensure imported data is lawful, accurate, and authorized. The actual user is responsible for draw rules, result publication, and related outcomes.
4. Prohibited conduct. Do not use the software for unlawful discrimination, deception, security bypass, or access-control bypass. Do not violate GNU GPLv3 when modifying or distributing the software.
5. Data and external integration. Data is stored locally by default. Startup registration and secrandom:// external links are optional and remain subject to enabled integration and security settings.
6. Disclaimer. The software is provided as is. To the extent permitted by law, the project makes no warranty about suitability, availability, or draw results.
7. Updates and termination. Material changes increase this agreement version and require renewed acceptance. You may stop using the software at any time.
8. GPLv3. This agreement does not replace or restrict GNU GPLv3 rights for source code, modifications, and distribution.
